{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash
#FLUX: --job-name=TestGPUOnSaga
#FLUX: --time=00:05:00
#FLUX: --qos=devel
#FLUX: --queue=accel
#FLUX: --gpus=1

# The Slurm '--account' directive has no direct equivalent in Flux and has been omitted.
# Account/project information is often handled by site-specific configurations, and its omission may lead to the job being charged to a default account.

# The Slurm directive '--mem-per-cpu=4G' does not have a direct equivalent in Flux and has been omitted.
# The performance implication is that the job may be scheduled on a node without enough memory, potentially causing it to fail.

set -o errexit  # Exit the script on any error
set -o nounset  # Treat any unset variables as an error

module --quiet purge  # Reset the modules to the system default
module load TensorFlow/2.6.0-foss-2021a-CUDA-11.3.1
module list

# Setup monitoring
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=timestamp,utilization.gpu,utilization.memory \
	--format=csv --loop=1 > "gpu_util-$FLUX_JOB_ID.csv" &
NVIDIA_MONITOR_PID=$!  # Capture PID of monitoring process
# Run our computation
python gpu_intro.py
# After computation stop monitoring
kill -SIGINT "$NVIDIA_MONITOR_PID"
"
}
